name: Maris Orgel
source:
As a maid serving Linestad family, she is the only person who continues staying by Shelly's side even after the decline of Linestad family.
She is now working at the cafe with Shelly, and her cooking is well received.
She is reticent, clam and reliable, watching over naive Shelly in the shadow.

[Translated from [url=http://products.web-giga.com/clarias/]official website[/url]]
